neighbours.label: Exceptional power or fighting ability of a person or force ('fighting ability was far', 'magical power', 'skilled in sword', 'superior firepower'); the same characters and armies described in other ways stay quiet.
fire: Her spell-casting ability was far above any rival's.
The knight has immense physical power and speed.
As a duelist she is deadly with a rapier.
The legion's superior weapons gave it the upper hand.
He is the greatest swordsman in the kingdom.
Few could match the sorcerer's raw magical strength.
Their tanks were vastly better than the enemy's.
This assassin is highly trained in unarmed combat.
quiet: Her bakery's sales were far above any rival's.
The knight has a small castle and a horse.
As a child she lived near the old fort.
The legion's weary cooks gave it a late supper.
He is the youngest soldier in the kingdom.
Few could recall the sorcerer's old family name.
Their tanks were painted green at the enemy's border.
This assassin is originally from a northern village.
